Police said the vehicle tried to escape after being stopped at a toll gate in Tamil Nadu’s Coimbatore district. Head Constable Velmurugan climbed onto the roof as the SUV sped along a highway, covering more than 25 miles and reaching speeds of over 60 mph, according to local reports. Police eventually stopped the vehicle and arrested three suspects, finding about 440 pounds of gutkha, a chewing tobacco product, inside, authorities said. | CBS News
